sourceNotes.dataOrigin: Existing Elarvess NPC seeds, the Town/Grassland Plains immersive template, and the Town/Plains Grassland visitable-location catalogue.
sourceNotes.scope: Elarvess settlement only; no other provinces or settlements.
sourceNotes.locationClarification: Canonical place names now come from exactly identified map building IDs. Former generic source location labels are resolved to these IDs; no aliases remain in active records.
sourceNotes.catalogClarification: The 259 goods/services are inventory and price examples from the matching Town–Grassland Plains template, grouped by source-designated vendor wording. Compound labels (e.g. Inn or tavern) are options, not evidence of specific Elarvess shop ownership.
sourceNotes.schedulesClarification: Original time blocks retained for provenance, but each location now uses a canonical Elarvess building name.
sourceNotes.relationshipClarification: All four source relation categories are retained verbatim per NPC; directed edge index duplicates them for database use.
sourceNotes.romanticExpansion: Legacy seed records synchronized with full V7 current/ended romantic and kinship records.
